```{r, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(gridExtra)
library(fields)
library(asbio)
library(MuMIn)
library(regclass)
```

```{r}
EIA <- read_csv("EIA.csv")

EIA <- EIA |>
  mutate(tidestate = as.factor(tidestate),
         density = count/area)
```

```{r}
# month as continuous
fit.full <- lm(density ~ tidestate + observationhour + DayOfMonth + MonthOfYear + impact + Year + x.pos + y.pos, data = EIA)
summary(fit.full)
AIC(fit.full)

# month as a factor
fit.full.fac <- lm(density ~ tidestate + observationhour + DayOfMonth + as.factor(MonthOfYear) + impact + Year + x.pos + y.pos, data = EIA)
summary(fit.full.fac)
AIC(fit.full.fac)
VIF(fit.full.fac)
```

```{r}
fit.fullfac.noyr <- update(fit.full.fac, .~. - Year)
fit.fullfac.noimp <- update(fit.full.fac, .~. - impact)
AIC(fit.full, fit.full.fac, fit.fullfac.noimp, fit.fullfac.noyr)
```

```{r}
fit.interac <- update(fit.fullfac.noimp, .~. + Year*x.pos + Year*y.pos)

summary(fit.interac)
```

```{r}
dredge(fit.interac, options(na.action = 'na.fail'))
```

```{r}
step(fit.interac, direction = "both")
```


```{r}
n <- nrow(EIA)
step(fit.interac, direction = "both", k = log(n))


```

```{r}
AIC_selected_mod <- lm(density ~ observationhour + Year + x.pos + y.pos, data = EIA)
summary(AIC_selected_mod)

str(summary(AIC_selected_mod))

sum((fitted(AIC_selected_mod) - EIA$density)^2) / 27793
```
